guitar.guitaristsText: Keith Richards / Ronnie Wood / Mick Taylor
guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster ('Micawber', 5-string open-G) / Gibson Les Paul / ES series
guitar.evidence: Keith Richards' 5-string open-G-tuned Telecaster 'Micawber' is one of the most famous specific guitars in rock history; this justifies high rather than medium confidence.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high due to Richards' very specifically documented guitar/tuning setup.

tone.target: jangly open-G rock crunch with bright bite
tone.profile: jangly open-G rock crunch with bright bite
tone.summary: A classic British tweed/Plexi style chain using a light boost, mild distortion, Chorus for bite, followed by the UK 50 amp model into a vintage 4x12 cabinet.

rig.name: The Rolling Stones - Start Me Up - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm playing.
Slightly boost the signal and add initial bite for the open-G riff feel.
blocks.gap: A dedicated 'Open G' tone shaper is unavailable, so a general Boost is used to enhance attack.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary tight, crunchy drive reminiscent of Plexi/tweed amps without heavy saturation.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen for its classic British crunch tone, matching the 'Plexi' clue.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if more warmth is desired)

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle, bright twangy shimmer and enhance the 'jangly' quality of the open-G riff.
blocks.gap: Chorus is used to add dimension and bite, compensating for the lack of specific 'twang' or 'jangle' module.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate tone of a classic British tweed/Plexi amplifier.

alternatives.model: UK 45 (if slightly more grit is needed)

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary high-end clarity for the 'bright bite'.

alternatives.model: UK Basket 4x12 (if a slightly more open tone is desired)

blocks.purpose: Scoop the low end slightly and boost the high-mids/treble to achieve 'bright bite' and open-G clarity.
Add subtle rhythmic depth and space without muddying the tight rhythm feel.
blocks.gap: A simple, short delay is used to add dimension while keeping the tone dry and focused on the riff.

blocks.purpose: Provide a minimal amount of natural room ambience to ground the sound without losing definition.
blocks.gap: The reverb is kept very low (low Mix) to maintain the 'dry and riffy' requirement.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more controlled, metallic decay is preferred)

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation to better capture the bright, open-G twang and bite required for 'Start Me Up'.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, twangy bite and open-G clarity.
